The problem: no time, no budget, and the DIY options do not fit

You run a small business. You are not short on things to do — you are short on the one thing a website takes: uninterrupted hours to learn a tool, write copy, and fight with a layout. Hiring a developer or an agency to build a simple site can run well past a thousand dollars and take weeks of back-and-forth. That is a lot to spend before you have proof the site brings in a single customer.

So most owners try a do-it-yourself builder instead. The cheap ones produce sites that look like every other cheap site — the same templates, the same stock layout, nothing that says this business is real and run by someone who cares. The more capable ones ask you to learn a drag-and-drop editor that eats an entire weekend before you have a homepage you are willing to share. Either way, you end up with something that took too long or looks like it did not.

How Kodely fits

Kodely skips both problems. You describe your business in plain English in a chat interface — what you do, who you serve, what you want on the page. Kodely generates a real application from that description: a Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 project made of actual component files, not a static mockup or a page of raw HTML. You watch a live preview render the real compiled app as it is built, so you are looking at the actual site, not an approximation of it.

When it looks right, one click publishes it to a real public URL at your own <name>.kodely.site address, free, included in every plan. Need to change something later? Describe the change in chat and Kodely edits the real components behind the scenes. Every successful generation is saved as a checkpoint, so if a change goes sideways, rolling back costs nothing. And if you want to see exactly what was built, the code view shows you the actual generated source files, in-app, that you can read and copy.

Three businesses this is built for

A local service business

A plumber, an electrician, a cleaning company, a landscaper. What these sites need is not complicated: hours, service area, a list of what you offer, a phone number that is easy to find, and something that signals a real, established business when someone searches your name after getting a referral. Describe the services and the service area in chat, and Kodely builds exactly that.

A small shop

A boutique, a bakery, a bike shop — a business where the website's job is to answer where are you, when are you open, and what do you carry, then get the visitor to walk in or call. An informational site that looks intentional does that job well, and it is exactly what Kodely is built to produce fast.

A one-person consultancy

Freelancers and independent consultants often put off having a website entirely because a portfolio site feels like a project of its own. Describing your services, your background, and how to reach you in chat gets you a page that looks like you took your business seriously — because a credible site is often the difference between a prospect emailing you and moving on to the next search result.

What Kodely is honest about not doing yet

Kodely builds the front end of your site — the pages, the layout, the content, the design. It does not generate a backend, a database, user accounts, or payment processing, so if your business needs online ordering or an appointment-booking system built into the site, that is not what Kodely does today. Sites also publish to a *.kodely.site subdomain rather than a custom domain, and editing happens through chat rather than a click-to-edit visual canvas. For a professional informational site — the kind most small businesses actually need first — none of that gets in the way. It matters if you were expecting a full ordering or booking platform out of the box.

Pricing, in plain terms

Every account starts with 750 free credits on signup, no credit card required, which is enough to build and publish a real site. A build that fails to compile is never charged, so you are only paying for work that actually ships. When you need more, credits are sold in top-ups and never expire:

Top-upCredits

$906,000 credits

There is one pricing structure for everyone — no separate tiers to compare, no feature you are locked out of until you upgrade. Full details are on the pricing page.

Get your site up today

You do not need a developer, a design tool, or a free weekend to have a real, publishable website. Describe your business, watch it get built, and put it live in one click.

Start building free — or see more examples on the blog.
